title: Izanami
body:
Syntax: perform izanami <target>

Description: Traps a target in a recursive loop. The target guesses one fixed hidden number, one guess per round, to escape; others cannot attack the trapped target. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. The target must be in your room; moving away before a delayed cast resolves makes it fizzle. Costs 70 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 60 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
